reservation: UTC second at `scripts/release.sh now`; explicit coordinates must be reserved the same UTC day, be later than every published v2 coordinate, and not lie in the future
form: YYMMDDhhmmss.0.0 (no short form, no prerelease or build suffix)
ordering: numeric on the first segment, identical to fixed-width string order; cross-era ordering only through release_sequence and this anchor
release_sequence: 1-based ordinal of the tag in `git tag --sort=creatordate | release_version::tag_filter`

legacy.form: yy.mm.dd[.hh.mm] (Vienna day; Paimos used hh.mm, the doctrine long form is hh.mm.ss)
